title: Migration Replay Gate
user: A team using schema snapshots and migrations that needs to replay an intended change against a disposable database and identify unsafe or non-idempotent operations before an environment apply fails.
smallest_useful_product: CLI starts a disposable Postgres database, seeds selected schema-state fixtures, applies a migration/diff command twice and after a partial state, captures SQL/errors, and labels non-idempotent/destructive outcomes.
success_measure: In a fixture suite with known duplicate-table, destructive, and clean changes, it correctly identifies each outcome and blocks the unsafe cases in CI.
constraints: Run only disposable containers; require user-supplied migration command; make destructive test fixtures explicit; never accept production connection strings.
